title: Koke kara Hajimaru Isekai Life
titleNative: 苔から始まる異世界ライフ
synonyms: Starting Life from Moss in Another World
synopsis: Hikaru, who died at just 20 years old, was granted reincarnation in another world by a goddess's mercy. But due to a mistake, he wasn't reborn as a human; he became moss! “I'll die for real if I don't do something!” Terrified to begin his new life as the weakest possible creature with abysmal stats, Hikaru strategizes how to survive using his rebirth bonus: Additional Skill Acquisition. As he defeats nearby small animals with his chosen skills and newly learned magic to grind levels, he makes an incredible discovery: his moss form can evolve into other species. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

synopsis: In modern times, it seems like the world only has need for extroverts. They're fun, sociable, thoughtful, and basically top-tier humans. But Yoshida isn't like that... So what if he's a hopeless introvert? So what if he always sits alone in the corner of the classroom? Enter Shigure, a classmate who is in the same boat. She boldly declares she's going to become an extrovert, and she challenges Yoshida to do the same...!? Watch as these two high school students try to make the most of their youth, while they still can!
